name: Lindsey Graham
description: Follow Lindsey Graham, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: South Carolina's governor appoints Lindsey Graham's sister to serve out his term
changes.summary: South Carolina Gov. Henry McMaster says he is appointing Darline Graham to finish the term of her late brother, former Republican Sen. Lindsey Graham, who died in office Saturday at age 71.

changes.title: Trump says he doesn't see a lot of "evil" in Lindsey Graham's death when asked about FBI probe
changes.summary: President Trump took questions in the Oval Office and commented on an apparent FBI probe into Lindsey Graham's death, saying he doesn't see a lot of "evil" behind the sudden incident.

changes.title: Darline Graham is sworn in as senator to fill her brother Lindsey Graham’s seat
changes.summary: Darline Graham was sworn in Tuesday afternoon to fill the seat of her older brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., three days after he died unexpectedly.

changes.title: Lindsey Graham's sister sworn in to Senate to fill his seat
changes.summary: Sen. Darline Graham was sworn in to fill the vacant seat of her brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, after he died unexpectedly.

changes.title: Darline Graham sworn in as senator after her brother's death
changes.summary: Darline Graham, the sister of the late South Carolina Sen. Lindsey Graham, was sworn in by the Senate on Tuesday afternoon — filling the seat just three days after her brother's death.

changes.title: Darline Graham, sister of Lindsey Graham, sworn in to fulfill his Senate term
changes.summary: Lindsey Graham’s younger sister appointed by South Carolina’s governor three days after senator’s death Darline Graham Nordone: Lindsey Graham’s sister and interim US senator Darline Graham, the sister of the late Republican senator Lindsey Graham, was sworn in to temporarily fill his Senate seat on Tuesday, just three.

changes.title: Who could replace Lindsey Graham in the Senate after his sudden death?
changes.summary: South Carolina Sen. Lindsey Graham's sudden death late Saturday has set off a scramble for who will succeed him in the Senate.

changes.title: Republican strategist on what he'll remember most about Lindsey Graham
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham is being remembered for his wit and political effectiveness after his sudden death over the weekend. Republican strategist Matt Whitlock joins CBS News to discuss.

changes.title: Lindsey Graham's Sister to Serve the Rest of His Senate Term
changes.summary: New details are emerging about the final moments of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham and what may have been his final phone call. It comes as his sister, Darline Graham Nordone, prepares to take the oath of office to serve the rest of her brother’s term, which ends in January. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Lindsey Graham’s Sister Appointed to Finish His Senate Term After Trump’s Backing
changes.summary: Gov. Henry McMaster of South Carolina named Darline Graham Nordone to replace Mr. Graham, who died on Saturday.
